summary: An owner’s objection ends one reservoir proposal while leaving its own idea unfiled.
realLife: The Lake Hornwoggin applicant withdrew after the Ohio reservoir’s corporate owner objected and indicated it might submit another name.
inGame: needs: the owner’s objection, the applicant’s withdrawal and any separate replacement application.

turns.what: The clerk closes the withdrawn case.
turns.writesBack: The docket contains no replacement proposal.

turns.pulledBy: The owner submits a complete alternative.
turns.writesBack: The new name receives its own review.
